name: Kiyosato (Japan)
description: A white field charged at the centre with the Kiyosato town emblem in red: an outlined ring enclosing a three-pointed star.
history: Municipal flag of Kiyosato, a town in Hokkaido; like most Japanese municipal flags it shows the municipal emblem on a plain field. Flag and emblem were adopted in 1953.

features.role: Kiyosato town emblem — an outlined ring enclosing a three-pointed star
